roll_call: I was born Gongsun Yang in the state of Wey and became Lord Shang in Qin. I chose laws meant to build a strong state.
I spoke to Duke Xiao of the imperial way and the kingly way, but he would not wait generations. So I offered the methods of a strong state.
I set laws for my own age instead of preserving old rites. Qin grew strong under those laws.
deploy: Do not hesitate. An uncertain course wins neither achievement nor renown.
Grant rank to those who earn it in battle. Do not preserve hereditary privilege for nobles who will not fight.
Make the law clear first. The people will follow only when ruler and ministers observe it together.
battle_win: The people could not join in planning the beginning, but now they can share in the success.
Rank went to those who earned merit, not merely to noble houses. Qin grew strong by that rule.
I unified laws, weights, and measures. Qin now moves under the same commands.
battle_draw: The state grew strong quickly, but it did not match the virtue of Shang and Zhou. That is the limit of the path I chose.
I used rewards to drive achievement and punishments to impose order. Resentment grew with them.
I will take bitter words as medicine. Sweet praise alone cannot show me my faults.
battle_lose: The law I made turned me away at the inn. Now I see how far its harm has reached.
When Duke Xiao died, my power ended with him. I made laws, but I could not erase his heir's resentment.
Qin kept my reforms. I was executed by dismemberment on a charge of rebellion.
clash_attack: I will not discuss reform with those who cling only to old institutions. A new age requires new laws.
Do not place noble blood above the law. Even the heir's offense must carry consequences.
Do not block reform with common opinion. Ordinary people cling to old customs, and scholars drown in what they have heard.

Duke Xiao would not wait for kingly virtue. I gave him laws for wealth and war.
I replaced old rites with laws for my age. Qin grew strong under them.
deploy: Do not hesitate. Doubt wins neither merit nor a name.
Reward battlefield merit. Abolish hereditary privilege.
Make the law clear. Ruler and minister must obey it first.
battle_win: The people could not plan the reform, but they can share its fruits.
I gave rank for merit, not noble birth. Qin grew strong.

battle_draw: Qin grew quickly, but never matched Shang or Zhou in virtue. That was my limit.
Rewards drove merit and punishments imposed order. Resentment grew beside them.
I will take bitter words as medicine. Sweet praise hides my faults.
battle_lose: My own law barred me from an inn. Only then did I see its harm.
Duke Xiao died, and my power followed. His heir still wanted vengeance.
Qin kept my reforms. I was torn apart for rebellion.
clash_attack: Do not let old laws block reform!
Noble blood does not stand above the law!
Do not let old customs stop reform!

roll_call: At thirteen I sang in the chorus of musicals. At twenty-one I put my loneliness into three chords.
I am neither male nor female. I am simply myself, and I finally found the words to explain that.
As a child, I turned the three steps in our kitchen into a stage. I still sing to an audience with that same feeling.
deploy: Do not try to sound clever. Speaking honestly is enough.
If you have said everything you need to say, do not force in a bridge. Leave some space in the song.
Keep going onstage even when it frightens you. Repetition helped me build confidence.
battle_win: I spoke my mind with only three chords. I did not need to make it complicated.
Jimmy and I stayed late and layered my voice. We made the sound ourselves without a choir.
I sang honestly about my life, and people understood me a little better.
battle_draw: I sang again after vocal surgery, but learning did not end. I still take voice lessons.
The old lyric was true to who I was then, but it no longer fit who I am now. So I changed it onstage.
Sometimes I want to make an audience cry, and sometimes I want them to dance. I need both kinds of stage.
battle_lose: In 2019, I experienced panic attacks and anxiety for the first time. Success did not protect me from them.
I damaged my vocal cords and had to cancel shows. While my fans waited, I focused on recovering my voice.
For a while, I was afraid to put happiness and desire into my music. I do not hide them now.
clash_attack: Do not explain my body or gender for me. I will tell you who I am.
Do not decide that loneliness is my only story. I also put happiness and desire into my music.
Do not treat me as a finished singer. If Stevie Wonder still takes lessons, I have no reason to stop.
